headline: Anti-Government Protests and Unrest Spread to Frankfurt
summary: Protests over education policy and living costs escalated into unrest in Frankfurt, resulting in store looting and injuries to 100 police officers.
why: Frankfurt is the principal financial center of Germany and home to the European Central Bank and major commercial institutions.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: Civil unrest in major urban hubs reflects underlying socio-economic stress within Europe's largest economy.
